extDescription.message: Insert your favorite prompts straight into ChatGPT and Claude.

popupBody.message: Insert your favorite prompts into ChatGPT and Claude.

a11yNewPrompt.message: Create a new prompt, opens in a new tab

tooltipHasVariables.message: Fill in values on the web

a11yOpensNewTab.message: Needs values, so it opens in a new tab

a11yLocked.message: Unavailable right now, it uses a deleted part

statusEmpty.message: Favorite a prompt on the web and it will show up here.

statusInjected.message: The prompt is in the message box.

statusSignedIn.message: You can use your favorite prompts now.

errNotReady.message: Couldn't insert the prompt. The page isn't ready yet. Please try again in a moment.

errPartial.message: The prompt didn't fully make it into the message box. Please reload and try again.

errNoComposer.message: Couldn't find the message box. The page layout seems to have changed. Please reload and try again.

errLoadFailed.message: Couldn't load your favorites. The connection looks unstable. Please try again.

errLoginRequired.message: Sign in to use your favorite prompts right away.

errTabBlocked.message: Couldn't open a new tab. Your browser is blocking pop-ups. Please allow them from the right side of the address bar.

errLocked.message: This prompt uses a deleted part. Please restore the part or tidy up the blocks on the web, then try again.

optionsBody.message: Nothing to configure yet. Manage your favorite prompts on the web app.
